verdict.rationale: Whether a compliance and registered-agent software service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects into it. Nothing shows a public repository or an open license, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
